Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a real standing block-shaped bald figure with gray block glasses and a dark goatee. Input 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, a polished photo of a hand holding a different figure.
Retouch and re-render input 1 to match input 2's clear physical material texture, crisp handmade edges, subtle printed surface detail, clean neutral-cool gray photographic sweep, soft directional studio lighting and natural contrast. Keep the exact subject in input 1, its original viewing angle and pose: bald peach cuboid head, brown eyebrows, white eyes with dark rectangular pupils, distinctive protruding gray square eyeglass pieces with visible pale edges and gray temples, dark brown rectangular goatee around the open pale mouth, pale cream jacket, blue shirt, peach hands, black trousers and feet. Preserve every pixel pattern, physical geometry, seam and proportion. Do not copy the reference character or hand. Do not invent conventional curved eyeglasses or change the handmade square frame construction. No redesign, CGI or cartoon look.
Center the complete FIGURE itself horizontally and vertically, equal gray margins on both sides, clear space above the head and below the feet. Full silhouette should occupy about 76% of frame height. Seamlessly extend the gray backdrop left and right. Remove incidental background dust and distractions; retain fine real object texture and grounded soft contact shadows. No hands, additional objects, text, logos, borders, watermark, stretched edges, or blurred duplicate background.
